content: I'll start by reading the test image to identify the key visual features.

The test image shows green banana fruits with small dark brown circular lesions/spots on the peel. The bananas appear to be harvested. Key features: dark brown circular spots on fruit surface, multiple bananas affected.

Top candidates: Anthracnose (dark spots on fruit) and Cigar End Rot (affects banana tips). Let me view references starting with one from each class.
Anthracnose reference shows large blotchy brown lesions on yellow bananas — quite different from the small discrete spots on green fruit in the test image. Let me check Cigar End Rot next.
Cigar End Rot shows dark shriveled rot at the tip of green banana — also doesn't match the discrete spots spread across the fruit body in the test image. Let me check Cordana Leaf Spot next.
Cordana Leaf Spot shows large eye-shaped lesions on banana leaves — clearly a leaf disease, not matching fruit spots. Let me check Panama Disease.
Panama Disease shows yellowing leaves with brown necrosis — a foliar/systemic disease, not matching fruit spots. Let me check Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka.
Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka shows yellow/black lesions on banana leaves — leaf disease, not matching. Let me check Banana_Bunchy_Top_Virus.
Banana_Bunchy_Top_Virus shows dark streaking on banana leaves — not matching. Let me check Bunchy_Top.

Bunchy_Top shows stunted, bunched plant leaves — a whole-plant disease, not matching. All leaf/plant diseases clearly don't match. For my final view, I'll revisit Anthracnose to see if early-stage on green fruit matches the test image better.

This Anthracnose reference slide is very informative — it explicitly describes "small, black, circular specks on the skin of the fruits" as early symptoms, exactly matching the test image's pattern of discrete dark brown circular spots on green banana fruit. The slide also shows banana fruit images that visually align with the test image.

**Summary of analysis:**
- Test image: green banana fruits with small discrete dark brown/black circular spots on the peel
- **Anthracnose**: Shows fruit spots — small circular dark specks on fruit skin (early stage), progressing to larger sunken spots. **Best match.**
- Cigar End Rot: Tip rot on green bananas — doesn't match body spots
- Cordana Leaf Spot, Panama Disease, Yellow/Black Sigatoka, Banana Bunchy Top Virus, Bunchy Top: All leaf/plant diseases — clearly don't match fruit with circular spots

The test image is definitively a fruit disease with small circular spots, and Anthracnose is the only class that presents this way on banana fruit.
